text:
sara: quick heads up — new community model 'marlin-13b' popped up, repo + weights attached. before we spin up evals want a quick legal+quant triage. possible custom CLA and unclear origin.

raj: drop the link and i'll run a fast quant/perf smoke.

sara: https://huggingface.co/community/marlin-13b  hash: abc123def. author notes 'non-commercial redistribution prohibited' and a custom CLA in the repo root. also a note: 'may include third-party proprietary components'.

maria: @sara do NOT host or serve until legal reviews. custom CLAs often have downstream restrictions. please paste the exact license text here or email legal. also flag for export-control review if origin is ambiguous.

tom: infra note — if legal permits, we still need to verify hosting constraints (no multi-tenant hosting, geo restrictions, etc.). if CLA forbids SaaS hosting we must block hosted API for this model id.

raj: did a very quick quant smoke locally (non-prod): 4-bit quant runs but longer-context coherency drops. here's the command + brief logs:

```
./quantize --bits 4 marlin-13b.safetensors -o marlin-13b-4bit.safetensors
loading: marlin-13b.safetensors (27GB)
quantize: done, output marlin-13b-4bit.safetensors
inference: tokens/sec=45, p50 latency=120ms (local 3090)
eval: rouge-l diff -3.2 vs fp16 baseline
warning: some attention kernels fell back to slow path
```

eval-bot: ran eval set 'prod-regression-20' on the 4-bit artifact: 4/20 examples produced critical hallucinations (fabricated facts). FP16 baseline passes those. Recommendation: keep FP16 or 8-bit for customer-facing paths, run wider bakeoff before any rollout.

maria: please attach the CLA text. if it's custom we need to confirm: attribution requirements, redistribution prohibition, export-control country list, and any host/serve prohibition. send to legal@redwood.com and cc security if origin unknown.

sara: plan proposal — 1) legal reads CLA + confirms restrictions 2) security checks upstream origin and export controls 3) quant team runs 4/8/16-bit bakeoff with our regression set + latency/cost matrix 4) product decides priority after quality pass. tagging rollout board. @tom can you temporarily block hosted rollout for model id 'marlin-13b'?

tom: yep — adding a hosted-policy ACL and model block now. will set a tag `blocked:legal-review` on the model registry entry.

maria: noted. if CLA forbids hosting we can still allow private deployments with explicit customer consent and cleared VA. will confirm once I read text.

sara: thanks. i'll upload the repo LICENSE.md and the sha to the ticket and ping legal thread. everyone: quick reactions appreciated so we can triage priority. :thumbsup: :eyes:
